_comment: Canonical prompt set for benchmarked sample generation. These prompts align to configs/benchmark_eval_set.json so checkpoint sample outputs can be scored repeatably across runs. Temperature is set to 0.0 (greedy) for reproducibility.
prompts: Write a Python function max_of_two(a, b) that returns the larger integer.
What does this Python expression output: [x*x for x in range(4)]
All birds have wings. A sparrow is a bird. Does a sparrow have wings? Answer yes or no.
If five machines make five widgets in five minutes, how many widgets do 100 machines make in five minutes?
